sources.researchNote: The notice gives 27 May 1908 in Papeete, Tahiti, and 6 January 2011 in Bazas, Gironde. It describes Rey as a Tahitian composer, singer and musician and records Tihoti-Ré and Tihoti-Re as pseudonymous forms. Its cited sources include the Pathé disc of “O chant d’amour de Tahiti !” and Claude Lestrade’s 1992 article in the Journal de la Société des océanistes.

personNameVariants.publicNote: Tahitian pseudonym, given in the BnF person authority record as Tihoti-Ré or Tihoti-Re, with a see-also reference under that form. Tihoti is the Tahitian rendering of Georges. The Pathé disc credits the performing group as Tihoti-ré et son ensemble tahitien and names Tihoti in the vocal duo, so the composer credited as G. Rey and the singer credited as Tihoti are the same man.
